{{Short description|Probability distribution}}
{{one source |date=April 2024}}
In [[probability theory]] and [[statistics]], the '''poly-Weibull distribution''' is a continuous probability distribution.  The distribution is defined to be that of a [[random variable]] defined to be the smallest of a number of [[statistical independence|statistically independent]] random variables having non-identical [[Weibull distribution]]s.
